card_text:
Relation: identical canonical target
Both aliases resolve to the same canonical entity.
The normalized and stored identifiers select one record.
The two keys are exact redirects to one target.
rationale: Both sides collapse to the same canonical target, so their geometry is Coincident.

card_text:
Relation: structural part of
A keyboard is part of a laptop.
A scene is part of a film.
A rack is part of a data center.
rationale: The first item occupies a contained structural role relative to the second, which is Proximal.

card_text:
Relation: created by
The novel was created by its author.
The mural was created by the artist.
The patch was created by the contributor.
rationale: Creation links distinct entities through attribution rather than containment, so it is Overlay.

card_text:
Relation: connected with
The initiative is connected with the department.
The device is connected with the service.
The person is connected with the event.
rationale: The relation is underspecified across examples, so no stable geometry class is justified.
